dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High boundary sharpness between alternating black and white transverse bars on the visible flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, roughly triangular bright red patch on the posterior nape region.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Diffuse and continuous transition with low color contrast between the crown and mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: The bird exhibits high-contrast black and white transverse barring on the rectrices, matching the pattern on the flight feathers.
